name: Forge Auto International Ltd
about: Forge Auto International Limited, incorporated in 2001, is an engineering company specializing in the forging and manufacturing of complex, safety-critical, forged, and precision-machined components for the automotive and non-automotive sectors.[1]
keyPoints: Product Portfolio[1] The company manufactures short and long forks, flange yokes, ball studs, gear blanks, and stub axle assemblies for commercial vehicles, railway bogies, tractors, agricultural equipment, and sledgehammers.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 28.6%
Debtor days have improved from 51.9 to 37.4 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
